baseline_models.focus_anchor: The plural call at word 1, the totalizer at word 3, fruit at word 4, and the circumstantial plural of security at word 5.
baseline_models.mechanism: Speech draws desired produce near; totality widens the selectable range; fruit supplies pleasant nourishment; settled security removes scarcity, refusal, and danger from the request loop.

activation_trace.role: Calling by voice literally draws something near and functions here as the actuator of provision.
Comprehensive totality expands the request from one item to an unrestricted repertoire.
Pleasant produce supplies the concrete object whose availability is being universalized.
Settled safety and trust make desiring, asking, receiving, and consuming free of threat.

changed_reading.before: They ask for every kind of fruit while safe.
changed_reading.after: They inhabit a speech-responsive provisioning order in which any pleasant produce can be drawn near without exposure to refusal, scarcity, or harm.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The plural subject of word 1 and the material-and-verbal branch range of word 4, held within the security of word 5.
baseline_models.mechanism: The call can invite or converse as well as request, while the fruit root also carries congenial talk; material enjoyment and unguarded sociability therefore coexist rather than compete.

activation_trace.role: The voice-based call can draw persons into exchange as readily as it draws requested things near.
Totality lets the delight include every register of the gathering, not only a quantity of produce.
Fruit keeps the reading materially anchored in edible pleasure.
Pleasant joking talk activates a simultaneous convivial layer inside the edible scene.
Security permits speech and enjoyment without social vigilance or fear.

changed_reading.before: The verse lists private consumption on demand.
changed_reading.after: The fruit course is also a safe social medium: calling, inviting, and congenial talk circulate together with what is eaten.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The claim branch of word 1 is constrained by totality at word 3, delight at word 4, and trusting confirmation at word 5.
baseline_models.mechanism: Calling shades into asserting recognized access; comprehensive delight is not anxiously begged for but approached as an acknowledged entitlement whose reliability is confirmed by the final state of trust.

activation_trace.role: Claiming a right or affiliation turns the request into an assertion of recognized access.
Completeness gives that access exhaustive rather than rationed scope.
Delighted ease defines the benefit to which access is asserted.
Trusting confirmation makes the asserted access feel recognized and dependable.

changed_reading.before: They petition a provider for desired items.
changed_reading.after: They exercise acknowledged, comprehensive access to delight; the utterance sounds less like anxious petition than a claim the order already recognizes.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier distribution of every affair as something distinguished and made firm backlights every fruit as a complete set of discrete, intelligible options rather than an undifferentiated heap.

activation_trace.role: Focus totality supplies the exhaustive range that the earlier distributive frame reorganizes.
Fruit gives the differentiated range a concrete menu-like anchor.
Distinguishing one thing from another makes total abundance internally articulated.
The earlier occurrence of comprehensive totality establishes the repeated distributive template.
Firm exactness turns differentiated options into a reliable order rather than scattered excess.

structural_cues: 44:4 places the same totalizer inside a verb of distribution before 44:55 places it before fruit.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies distinction, totality, and exactness; I transfer their organization from affairs to available fruit. A live alternative is that the repeated totalizer signals only broad inclusiveness.

changed_reading.before: Every fruit denotes sheer exhaustive abundance.
changed_reading.after: Every fruit denotes a fully differentiated repertoire: abundance remains complete while each desired kind stays distinct and callable.

context_deltas.mechanism: Merciful orientation plus literal hearing closes the implied circuit behind the call: a voiced desire is received and answered, so the scene is relational provision rather than impersonal self-service.

activation_trace.role: The spoken call supplies the outgoing signal whose reception the context activates.
Settled trust marks confidence that the communicative circuit will not fail.
Tender mercy gives the hearer a benevolent orientation toward the caller's need.
Literal reception of sound supplies the missing receptive side of the focus call.

structural_cues: 44:6 joins mercy, hearing, and knowledge in one clause, while 44:55 foregrounds a plural act of calling.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a benevolent hearer and a voiced call; I infer that hearing enables fulfillment. The alternative is that the attributes remain general and do not specify the provisioning mechanism.

changed_reading.after: Their calls participate in a dependable address-and-response relation: desire can be voiced because it is mercifully heard.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier speech seeks emergency removal and uses professed belief beside danger; a later prophetic call reports an impasse. In the focus, the same call-and-security roots are recomposed so speech expresses free preference after crisis has ended.

activation_trace.role: The focus call retains the same voice-driven approach but changes what speech must accomplish.
Settled safety makes the focus call non-emergency speech.
Lifting a covering supplies the urgent requested relief against which later free requesting is measured.
The response-seeking amen branch makes the profession beside the plea resonate as an attempted closure demanding an answer.
The prophetic call supplies a second voice act produced by danger and blocked human response.

structural_cues: 44:12 voices a plea for removal, 44:22 records a prophetic call after rejection, and 44:55 finally depicts calling from inside safety.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies three calls or response-seeking scenes under different conditions; I infer a temporal transformation from survival speech to preference speech. The alternative is that the calls share a root without forming a trajectory.

changed_reading.before: The blessed ask for luxury while already safe.
changed_reading.after: The luxury includes emancipation of speech itself: voices once forced into pleas and reports of crisis can now articulate preference without emergency.

context_deltas.mechanism: An earlier population occupied gardens and luxury in delighted or insolent ease, then left it all for other inheritors. The focus pairing of every delight with safety therefore adds security of tenure: enjoyment is no longer shadowed by forced abandonment or transfer.

activation_trace.role: Pleasant enjoyment anchors the focus in the same experiential domain as the earlier luxury.
Security now functions as durability of access as well as absence of immediate fear.
Abandoning and relinquishing supplies the precarity that the focus state reverses.
Earlier delighted ease establishes that pleasure alone did not make possession secure.
Insolent exultance keeps alive the alternative that insecure luxury can be morally self-deceiving.
Transfer from a predecessor to an heir makes loss of tenure explicit.

structural_cues: 44:25-28 sequences gardens, springs, crops, pleasurable luxury, abandonment, and transfer to another people.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies enjoyed estates that are relinquished and inherited; I extend safety from bodily fear to continuity of access. The live alternative restricts the final participle to personal safety only.

changed_reading.before: They are unafraid while enjoying abundant fruit.
changed_reading.after: Their delight is nonconfiscable: unlike the earlier luxury that changed hands, every enjoyment can be approached without fear of dispossession, succession, or moralized swagger.

context_deltas.mechanism: The punishment sequence corrupts food, ingestion, belly, and tasting into imposed pain; immediately after the focus, tasting is severed from death and protection is explicit. Fruit in safety thus repairs the entire sensory act, not merely the menu.

activation_trace.role: Pleasant produce is the benign edible object that reverses punitive food.
Security extends through anticipation, ingestion, and aftermath of the fruit.
Taking and tasting food opens the earlier anti-banquet whose sensory valence is reversed.
Boiling and overflowing converts ingestion into internal injury, defining what safe eating excludes.
The command to taste makes sensory reception coercive before the focus restores chosen appetite.
Experiencing or being tried by something broadens the post-focus denial from flavor to terminal experience.
Active warding of harm confirms that focus security is protective, not merely affective calm.

structural_cues: 44:43-49 turns food, ingestion, the belly, and tasting into punishment; 44:56 immediately denies tasting death and states protection from the blaze.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed food and tasting sequences plus explicit protection; I infer that safety governs the whole appetite-to-aftermath chain. The alternative is a simpler heaven-versus-punishment contrast without a repaired sensory mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Safe names the diners' general condition while fruit names their food.
changed_reading.after: Safe qualifies appetite itself: they choose, taste, digest, and continue without food becoming coercion, internal injury, punishment, or death.

context_deltas.mechanism: The non-dominant split mapping lets the focus call retain a distant image of forceful driving. Set against the condemned person's violent dragging, agency flips: the safe inhabitants are not driven toward imposed consumption; their own speech directs provision toward them.

activation_trace.role: The split-root image of rough driving supplies a deliberately distant motion schema inside the focus verb.
Pleasant fruit anchors the reversed motion in the actual object requested.
Safety marks the regained agency as stable and noncoercive.
Violent hauling under compulsion supplies the contextual motion whose subject-object relation is reversed.

structural_cues: 44:47 makes the condemned person the object of imperatives to seize and drag; 44:55 makes the blessed plural the subject of calling.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies violent dragging and a non-dominant focus branch of rough driving; I reverse the directional roles from being driven to directing. The ordinary voice-call reading remains fully live and is more form-near.

changed_reading.before: They verbally order fruit while safe.
changed_reading.after: In an exploratory agency reversal, they no longer undergo forced movement toward imposed food; as grammatical subjects, they direct desired food toward themselves.

context_deltas.mechanism: The secure station of 44:51 becomes gardens and then the inside where secure people call. Repeated containment propagates safety from habitat to inhabitant and finally into each act of requesting.

activation_trace.role: Calling is the action performed inside the layered secure environment.
Personal settled security internalizes the safety first predicated of the station.
Residence in a place gives security a durable spatial substrate.
The secure place forms an outer envelope that the focus repeats as an inner human state.

structural_cues: 44:51-55 nests the group in a secure station, in gardens and springs, and then within that setting while calling safely.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated locative containment and the same security root on place and people; I infer safety propagates across those layers. The alternative treats the repetition as ordinary description without an enclosure mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Safe describes the emotional state of people who happen to be in a garden.
changed_reading.after: Safety is architectural and embodied: secure place, protected inhabitants, and consequence-free requesting form nested layers of one habitat.

context_deltas.mechanism: Mutual facing and pairing supply a social geometry for the plural callers. The talk branch of fruit then becomes functional rather than decorative: the provision circulates through a reciprocal gathering, not isolated appetite.

activation_trace.role: Calling can invite, address, and draw near within the assembled group.
Congenial joking talk supplies the interaction carried by the shared table.
Trust makes face-to-face conviviality unguarded rather than competitive.
Mutual face-to-face orientation gives the banquet a reciprocal social layout.
Joining each companion to a counterpart thickens the scene from co-presence into relation.

structural_cues: 44:53 places the inhabitants facing one another, 44:54 pairs them, and 44:55 retains a plural subject who calls within the same scene.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reciprocal orientation and pairing; I infer that calls and pleasant talk move through that social arrangement. The alternative reads facing and pairing as adjacent gifts unrelated to requesting fruit.

changed_reading.before: Each inhabitant privately summons an unlimited menu.
changed_reading.after: The menu is a reciprocal table: invitation, address, banter, and edible pleasure circulate among secure, mutually present companions.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus claim branch suggested recognized entitlement, but the post-scene naming of the whole outcome as gift relocates its ground. Access is assured enough to be claimed in use, yet it is conferred rather than self-originating.

activation_trace.role: Claiming a right preserves the felt assurance with which access is exercised.
Trusting confirmation supports dependable access without deciding its ultimate source.
Benefaction and gift supply the source that prevents assured access from becoming self-grounded entitlement.

structural_cues: 44:57 retrospectively labels the entire preceding outcome a favor from the addressee's Lord.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a claim image in the focus and a gift image after it; I distinguish confidence of use from ownership of source. The alternative activates favor as surplus or rank and leaves the claim model less qualified.

changed_reading.before: They claim every delight as an entitlement intrinsic to themselves.
changed_reading.after: They exercise gift-grounded access with the confidence of a recognized right, while its source remains benefaction rather than possession by desert.

context_deltas.mechanism: The coda's easy language and tongue send analogical backwash into the focus call: desire reaches expression without friction, and the social speech carried by the fruit root becomes lucid rather than effortful.

activation_trace.role: The spoken call provides the utterance whose ease the later language cue activates.
Pleasant social talk makes linguistic ease part of enjoyment rather than merely delivery infrastructure.
Opening into ease after difficulty removes friction from the imagined path between desire and speech.
Language and speech supply the concrete medium through which the focus call operates.

structural_cues: 44:58 follows the completed garden scene by stressing that the discourse has been made easy in the addressee's tongue.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies easy language after a verse of calling; I project that ease backward as an analogy for unimpeded expression. The live alternative confines 44:58 entirely to revelation and remembrance.

changed_reading.before: A request is effective once uttered.
changed_reading.after: Even forming and communicating desire is unburdened: provision and convivial speech answer to a tongue with no expressive friction.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it joins two dairy-production branches to a fruit clause; it remains anchored in the focus call and fruit roots and coheres as a renewal mechanism. Render it only as a material analogy for self-renewing provision, never as the lexical gloss of the verse.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Word 1 can activate a remnant that draws more yield, while word 4 can activate rich yield gathering before birth; words 3 and 5 constrain the result as complete and safe.

activation_trace.role: A retained remnant that draws subsequent milk supplies the recursive pull in the provision model.
Rich milk thickening before birth supplies an image of enjoyment already generating its next yield.
Completeness prevents the renewal image from implying partial or failing supply.
Security stabilizes renewal so that consumption does not threaten depletion.

changed_reading.before: An already stocked inventory answers repeated requests.
changed_reading.after: Each enjoyment imagistically carries the remainder or thickening that summons the next yield, so abundance behaves as safely self-renewing rather than merely stored.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the amen branch beneath the actual safe-participle form; it remains rooted in the final word and is strengthened by the opening call. Render it as a call-and-response resonance or enclosure, not as a syntactic identification of the participle with amen.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The clause opens with calling at word 1 and closes with the security root at word 5, whose inventory includes the response-seeking amen formula.

activation_trace.role: The voiced call creates the first half of a call-and-response contour.
The amen request for response makes the closing root resonate as an answer already sought and granted.
Actual settled safety contains the speculative amen resonance within the word's direct state sense.

changed_reading.before: Calling and being safe are separate facts at opposite ends of the clause.
changed_reading.after: The clause can be heard as a miniature call-and-response enclosure: they call, and the final security root lets the request resonate as already met.

strongest_changes: The verse became a speech-responsive provisioning system rather than a static inventory.
Earlier abandoned luxury made final security include nonconfiscable, morally unswaggering access.
Punitive food, coerced tasting, and violent dragging reversed into protected appetite and subject-controlled calling.
The immediate facing and pairing context preserved a coexisting convivial reading in which talk is part of the fruit-course delight.
summary.what_was_special: The split mapping of د ع و opened a contained agency reversal, while the ordinary call branch linked remote crisis speech to effortless preference. The same ف ك ه and ء م ن inventories kept material fruit, sociable talk, secure tenure, confirmed access, and a faint call-response resonance simultaneously live.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the pleasant-talk branch of ف ك ه actively co-describes the gathering or only colors the material fruit.
Whether security extends to continuity of tenure or primarily denotes freedom from personal fear.
Whether the amen resonance in the final root is productive wordplay or too form-distant to carry beyond an outlier.
Whether 44:58 legitimately projects ease back into the inhabitants' speech or concerns only transmission of the discourse.
